verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry and gateway, so runtime tool discovery through meta-tools is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence never documents meta-tools that let an agent search for and load tools on demand. Catalog search for users, per-tool enable/disable, and the Gateway proxy are adjacent features that do not deliver dynamic in-context tool loading.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
